# Copy Editing Skill for Muse

This skill is the polishing half of the pair: where the copywriting skill writes new copy, this one systematically improves EXISTING copy through seven sequential sweeps (clarity, voice and tone, the "so what" test, prove it, specificity, heightened emotion, zero risk), looping back to earlier sweeps after each pass. For high-stakes pages it can also run an optional expert-panel review: 3–5 personas scoring the copy 1–10 until it reaches publish-ready. Caveat: this is an iterative, multi-pass process — expect several rounds on important pages, and it assumes you bring the draft. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
